# orchestra_pipeline (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) Unique identifier. Letters, numbers, underscores only. Max 255.
- `data` (Attributes) Pipeline definition. See the pipeline schema reference for the full structure. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is published and can be triggered.

### Optional

- `storage_provider` (String) Must be ORCHESTRA for API-created pipelines.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the pipeline was created.
- `id` (String) The pipeline ID.
- `name` (String) The pipeline name.
- `num_tasks` (Number) Number of tasks in the pipeline.
- `paused` (Boolean) Whether the pipeline is paused.
- `updated_at` (String) When the pipeline was last updated.
- `yaml_path` (String) Path to the pipeline YAML file (null for API-created pipelines).
